name: Furniture & Product Design Plugin
description: AI-assisted design workflow plugin for furniture and industrial/consumer product design. Covers a 12-step workflow from Brief to Export, with 9 artifact types, 6 component categories (structural, hardware, connector, mechanism, surface, accessory), and 10 material contributions. Does NOT provide CAD runtime, parametric modelling, or simulation engines.

routesToMount.instruction: Add: import productDesignPluginRouter from './product-design-plugin.js'; then router.use(productDesignPluginRouter); at the end of the file.

integrationNotes: Domain schema is at artifacts/api-server/src/domains/furniture-product-design/schema.ts — self-contained, does NOT use @workspace/db barrel for table definitions.
productDesignPluginRouter must be registered in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts by Team 39.
7 public route exceptions must be added to PUBLIC_ROUTE_RULES in adminAuth.ts by Team 39.
DB tables must be created by running integration/migrations/team-28.sql against Supabase — controlled by Team 39.
ComponentDomain integration requires Team 8 cooperation (IR-28-01) — currently using local adapter.
AI generation falls back to rule-based output when OPENAI_API_KEY is unavailable.
Plugin does NOT provide CAD, parametric modelling, or simulation. assertNoCadRuntime() is called in generateStepOutput().
Access token is the sole IDOR guard for customer-facing routes — never accept numeric projectId from public callers.
Export requires project status = 'approved' — review gate cannot be bypassed.
testTargets: manifest: plugin manifest structure and completeness
workflow: 12 steps present, sequential, unique keys
artifact registry: all 9 artifact types registered
component contribution: all 6 categories registered with valid definitions
material contribution: all 10 materials with grades and sustainability notes
technical view metadata: view type, unit, scale, annotation validation
capability requirement: required AI capabilities declared
no CAD runtime: assertSupportedCapability and assertNoCadRuntime guards
no core leakage: domain is self-contained, status transitions guard review gate
version compatibility: semver fields present and consistent
